text:
Jaipur wasn't built pink. In 1876 the Maharaja had the whole old city painted pink to welcome the Prince of Wales, and a law the next year reportedly made pink compulsory there.

Your house, your wall, but not your colour. In 2017 the city even set aside about ₹14.6 crore to restore bazaar facades in the original shade.

Would you let your city choose your paint? #Jaipur
